{{search|supporting character from [[M20|I Choose You!]]|the lake in [[Sinnoh]]|Lake Verity}} {{CharInfobox |color={{skill color}} |corecolor={{white color}} |bordercolor={{SoulSilver color dark}} |name=Verity |jname=マコト |tmname=Makoto |slogan=no |image=Verity M20.png |size=120px |caption=Verity |gender=Female |hometown=[[Twinleaf Town]] |region=[[Sinnoh]] |relatives=Unnamed mother |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |enva=[[Suzy Myers]] |java=Shiori Sato }} '''Verity''' (Japanese: '''マコト''' ''Makoto'') is a major character who appeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]''. She is a vibrant and {{wp|tomboy}}ish [[Pokémon Trainer]] who seems to enjoy adventures. She is also one of {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}}'s {{ashfr|traveling companions}} in that {{pkmn|movie}}. ==In the movies== A resident of [[Twinleaf Town]] in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]], Verity is the daughter of a strong, famous {{pkmn|Trainer}}. However, she felt that she could not live up to her mother's expectations. Because of this, she decided to start her journey in the [[Kanto]] region after getting her [[first partner Pokémon]], a {{p|Piplup}}. Verity was first seen at a [[Pokémon Center]], where her Piplup was being treated. After receiving it back from [[Nurse Joy]], she noticed a wanted poster regarding {{TRT}}. She later raced out after hearing about a nearby sighting of {{p|Entei}}. Verity traveled along with {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} and [[Sorrel]] to [[Mount Tensei]], where {{an|Ho-Oh}} lives. ===Character=== {{incomplete|section}} ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Verity's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'': {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Verity |pkmn=Piplup |type1=Water |img=Verity Piplup.png |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |vaen=Michele Knotz |vajp=Etsuko Kozakura |desc={{p|Piplup}} is Verity's main Pokémon, spending much of its time [[Walking Pokémon|outside its Poké Ball]]. Piplup's known moves are {{m|Bubble Beam}}, {{m|Drill Peck}}, {{m|Hydro Pump}}, and {{m|Whirlpool}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Verity |pkmn=Lapras |type1=Water |type2=Ice |img=Verity Lapras.png |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |vaen=Chika Fujimura |vajp=Chika Fujimura |desc={{p|Lapras}} is a Pokémon Verity uses for transport across water. Verity brought out Lapras so she, [[Sorrel]] and {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} could cross a river after escaping from a group of angry {{p|Primeape}}. None of Lapras's moves are known.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable | color = {{skill color}} | bordercolor = {{SoulSilver color dark}} | ja = 佐藤栞里 ''Shiori Satō'' | cs = Viktorie Taberyová | da = Estrid Bøttiger | en = [[Suzy Myers]] | nl = Carré Albers | fi = Maruska Verona | it = Serena Clerici | ko = 문남숙 ''Mun Namsuk'' | es_eu = Sandra Villa | es_la = Azul Valadez | th = ธันวา ภักดีอำนาจ ''Thanwa Pakdeeamnat'' | sv = Mikaela Tidermark | vi = Hoàng Yến Chibi | pl = Magdalena Wasylik | ca = Ainhoa Máiquez }} ==In the games== {{bulbanews/2|Mew, Movie 20 Pokémon codes to be available at 7-Eleven in Japan|Mew, Movie 20 Pokémon codes to be available at Pokémon Centers, Stores in Japan}} A Japanese event [http://7spot-info.jp/pokemon_rally_2017/ distributed] an in-game representation of Verity's Piplup, along with [[Sorrel]]'s {{p|Lucario}} and {{Ash}}'s {{AP|Charizard}} via serial code and local wireless. The serial codes could be obtained by collecting two different virtual stamps via [http://webapp.7spot.jp/shops/ 7-SPOT] at {{wp|7-Eleven}} stores in Japan. The serial codes were available from August 1 to 20, 2017 at 7 am to 7 pm, and can be redeemed from August 1 to 28, 2017. The local wireless were available at {{OBP|Pokémon Center|store}} stores and [[Pokémon Store]]s in Japan from August 22 to September 3, 2017. {{G7event/head |ball=Poké |balllink=Poké Ball (item) |pokemon=Piplup |gender=m |level=30 |ndex=393 |type=Water |ot=マコト |id=170715 |ability=Torrent |nature=Hardy |fateful=yes |met=2017 Pokémon Movie |ribbon=Wishing |move1=Hydro Pump|move1type=Water|move1cat=Special|move1rel=yes |move2=Bubble Beam|move2type=Water|move2cat=Special|move2rel=yes |move3=Whirlpool|move3type=Water|move3cat=Special|move3rel=yes |move4=Drill Peck|move4type=Flying|move4cat=Physical|move4rel=yes }} {{G7event/entry|sm|serial code|Japanese|online|August 1 to 28, 2017}} {{G7event/entrybottom|sm|local wireless|all|{{OBP|Pokémon Center|store}} stores, Japan
